PluginData.Author: SentorX
PluginData.Tooltip: Live performance monitor, built to find the cause of lag
PluginData.Description:
Monitor measures what is hurting sim speed, including during the worst lag. It times the frame all the time, and on request it times every call, so a run names the grids, players, factions, scripts, mods and plugins that cost the most.
It notices lag by itself and gathers the evidence, and players can see what their own grids cost.
Commands start with !monitor. Add the Monitor Quasar plugin for history, charts, incidents and comparing servers.
Also available as a Torch plugin, both builds share the same code.
